title: JobFailureRequest
description: Safe flat failure update for one persistent background job.

job_id.description: UUID v7 identity of the job to fail.

correlation_id.description: UUID v7 trace identity for the atomic failure mutation.

expected_revision.description: Revision required to prevent a lost concurrent update.

error_message.description: Safe actionable failure message without raw errors.

error_retriable.description: Whether retrying the failed job is safe and permitted.
